+++ b/tests/test_container_enablement_idempotence.py
@@ -0,0 +1,40 @@
+import pytest
+
+from mistune import create_markdown
+from mistune.plugins.math import math_in_list, math_in_quote
+from mistune.plugins.table import table_in_list, table_in_quote
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "plugin, enable, attr, source, fragment",
+    [
+        ("table", table_in_quote, "block_quote_rules", "> A | B\n> - | -\n> 1 | 2\n", "<table>"),
+        ("table", table_in_list, "list_rules", "- A | B\n  - | -\n  1 | 2\n", "<table>"),
+        ("math", math_in_quote, "block_quote_rules", "> $$\n> x\n> $$\n", 'class="math"'),
+        ("math", math_in_list, "list_rules", "- $$\n  x\n  $$\n", 'class="math"'),
+    ],
+)
+def test_repeated_container_enabling_preserves_rules_and_rendering(plugin, enable, attr, source, fragment):
+    md = create_markdown(escape=False, plugins=[plugin, enable])
+    rules = getattr(md.block, attr)
+    initial_rules = list(rules)
+    expected = md(source)
+    assert fragment in expected
+    for _ in range(3):
+        md.use(enable)
+        assert getattr(md.block, attr) == initial_rules
+        assert md(source) == expected
+
+
+def test_reenabling_does_not_move_existing_rules_relative_to_other_extensions():
+    md = create_markdown(plugins=["table", "math", table_in_quote, math_in_quote])
+    rules = md.block.block_quote_rules
+    table_pos = rules.index("table")
+    rules.insert(table_pos, "block_html")
+    initial_rules = list(rules)
+    md.use(table_in_quote)
+    md.use(math_in_quote)
+    assert rules == initial_rules
+    assert rules.count("table") == 1
+    assert rules.count("nptable") == 1
+    assert rules.count("block_math") == 1
